_note: Observed topic frequencies in official ЭЕШ/ЭШ mathematics papers, mapped by hand to concepts.txt ids. Sources: official item bank eyeshitems.eec.mn (2021 A, 2022 A, 2023 A part 1, items visible publicly) and official PDFs from eec.mn (2022 A full, 2023 B part 2, 2025 A full; retrieved via web.archive.org). Each item counted once under its main concept; several items touch 2 concepts (see esh-exam.md). The mapping and the one-line descriptions are my own judgement, not an official classification (draft). share = count / mapped items; point_share weights by points (part 1: 1/2/3 pt, part 2: 7 pt each).
